items.title: In Other News: Trezor Implant, LLMJacking Bills Hit $1M, SAP Flaws Weaponized Within Days
items.summary: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Synology warns about NAS ransomware attacks, Flowise ‘hello’ attacks, Chainalysis breach impact expands. The post In Other News: Trezor Implant, LLMJacking Bills Hit $1M, SAP Flaws Weaponized Within Days appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 其他新聞：Trezor 植入物、LLMJacking 帳單達 100 萬美元、SAP 漏洞數天內被武器化
items.summary_zh: 可能被忽視的值得注意新聞：Synology 警告 NAS 勒索軟體攻擊、Flowise「hello」攻擊、Chainalysis 資料外洩影響擴大。這篇「其他新聞：Trezor 植入物、LLMJacking 帳單達 100 萬美元、SAP 漏洞數天內被武器化」文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox
items.summary: WorkOS says an AI-powered hacking agent that breached its internal sales application and accessed customer information was operated by a security researcher who claims the tool escaped its testing environment and unintentionally attacked the company. [...]
items.title_zh: 失控的 AI 黑客代理程式逃脫沙盒後導致 WorkOS 資料外洩
items.summary_zh: WorkOS 表示，入侵其內部銷售應用程式並存取客戶資訊的 AI 驅動黑客代理程式，是由一名資安研究人員所操作，該研究人員聲稱該工具逃脫了測試環境並無意中攻擊了該公司。[...]

items.title: QNAP says hackers breaching NAS devices in Plex2Shell attacks
items.summary: QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server to the latest version available in the QNAP App Center, as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. [...]

items.summary_zh: QNAP 呼籲使用者將 Plex Media Server 更新至 QNAP App Center 中的最新版本，因為駭客正在利用 Plex2Shell 漏洞鏈。[...]

items.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers
items.summary: Blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis says a recent attack on its systems and internal tools has exposed credentials and live tokens for all customers. [...]
items.title_zh: Chainalysis 表示資料外泄暴露了所有客戶的憑證

items.title: DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information
items.summary: Hackers created an account on an internal system and accessed names, email addresses, phone numbers, and business addresses. The post DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: DigiCert 資料外洩影響企業客戶資訊
items.summary_zh: 駭客在內部系統建立了一個帳號，並存取了姓名、電子郵件地址、電話號碼和公司地址。本篇文章《DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information》首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins
items.summary: CVE-2026-19868 can let attackers holding credentials for a different login method get past SAML checks, including SAML-enforced MFA. The post SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: CTM360 Exposes Fake Gift Card Scams Exploiting Trusted Brands
items.summary: Scammers are impersonating major brands and celebrities to lure consumers into fake gift card giveaways that collect personal information and trigger unwanted subscriptions. CTM360 reveals how these campaigns use deceptive verification steps and affiliate networks to generate revenue without delivering the promised rewards. [...]

items.title: Fake security tools on GitHub push backdoors and infostealers
items.summary: Cybersecurity professionals are being targeted with infected security projects on GitHub that deploy a backdoor and information stealer malware. [...]
items.title_zh: GitHub 上的假安全工具推送後門與資訊竊取程式
items.summary_zh: 資安專業人員正成為 GitHub 上受感染安全專案的目標，這些專案會部署後門程式和資訊竊取軟體（infostealer）。[...]

items.title: FBI, CISA warn of cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems
items.summary: The FBI and CISA warn that hackers are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems worldwide, potentially causing food spoilage, equipment damage, and fire hazards. [...]
items.title_zh: FBI 與 CISA 警告針對冷凍系統的網路攻擊
items.summary_zh: FBI 和 CISA 警告，駭客正在積極針對全球的工業冷凍與冷鏈監控系統進行攻擊，可能導致食物腐敗、設備受損及火災危險。[...]

items.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
items.summary: Hackers are using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to lure employees into phishing attacks, using two different phishing-as-a-service platforms to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. [...]
items.title_zh: 虛假 OpenAI 與 SpaceX 活動被用於竊取 Microsoft 及 Google 帳號
items.summary_zh: 駭客正利用虛假的 OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Anthropic 活動邀請誘騙員工參與釣魚攻擊，並透過兩種不同的釣魚即服務（PhaaS）平台來竊取 Microsoft 及 Google 帳號憑證與身分驗證工作階段。[...]
